subject: Pilot timeline proposal + security & procurement owners
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex@acmehealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot timeline proposal + security & procurement owners

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and a proposal to keep momentum:

What we heard
- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate inference latency and cost for EMR redaction flows.
- Hard constraints: FedRAMP-like controls for data in transit, SSO via Okta, and vendor questionnaire requirement from procurement.

Proposed next steps
1) Lock pilot kickoff: options below (pick one):
   • Option A: Jun 3 — 2 week prep, 4 week pilot
   • Option B: Jun 10 — standard kickoff cadence
   • Option C: Jun 24 — preferred if procurement needs extra review time
2) Schedule 45-min technical deep-dive (platform + SSO) — suggested slots in the follow-up calendar invite.
3) Loop in security & procurement owners — can you confirm who owns the security evidence (SOC 2 / data classification) and procurement/PO process?

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: pilot-scope-1pager.pdf (pdf)]

If you confirm preferred kickoff option and security/procurement contacts today, I’ll send invites and a short mutual action plan.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[kimberly@redwood.com]

From: Alex Barnes <alex@acmehealth.io>

Date: 2028-05-20T12:01:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline proposal + security & procurement owners

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear recap. We’re aligned and happy to move forward.

We’ll take Option B (kickoff week of Jun 10).

Security & procurement owners:
- Security evidence point: Maya Singh (m.singh@acmehealth.io) — she’ll own SOC2 and data classification questions.
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.io — PO process usually takes ~2 weeks after signature; they’ll need the vendor questionnaire back.

I attached our vendor security questionnaire to speed things along. Also: can you include a short section in the mutual action plan for sign-off owners and target dates?

Attachment: [Attachment: vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

1) Calendar: I’ll propose 3 slots for the 45-min technical deep-dive on Jun 12 (09:00-09:45 PT, 11:00-11:45 PT, 15:00-15:45 PT) — pls pick one and accept.

4) Procurement: if you can return the completed vendor questionnaire by May 27 we’ll include it with the PO packet to accelerate your internal approvals.
